entries.summary: Card Atlas art-forward design/build record: #798 fetchAsset-driven covers + bound hero, one normalized row + plugin-side sort across both hubs, PNG-first summon with JSON fold, the ONE-key art cache budgeting the shared egress belt, renderer F2 reading-measure cap + F4 house EmptyState + the hero height cap; build-time premise correction: the art batch FLOATS past the ~6s invocation settlement wall (measured live); rejected arms, coupled sites, found gaps (GC-bait fetched assets, belt sizing fork).

claims.claim: The detail stage caps its column at the house --reading-measure token and an empty grid renders the house EmptyState (stickler F2/F4), both landed red-first in the renderer.
fetchAsset shares one hourly egress belt with net.fetch (120/plugin), which is why the plugin's one-key art cache is load-bearing rather than an optimization.
netHosts matching is exact-host (suffix only for leading-dot entries), so each hub's art CDN is its own manifest entry and its own consent line.
